videoUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support embedded video.
audioUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support embedded audio.

error.networkMessage: The connection dropped while the file was loading. Check your connection and reload the page.
error.decodeMessage: Playback stopped: this file is damaged or uses a codec your browser cannot decode. Download it to play it locally.
error.unsupportedMessage: Your browser cannot play this format. Download the file to open it in a player of your own.
error.encryptedMessage: This file is encrypted and there is no key to decrypt it.

copyButton.copyFailedBlocked: Couldn't copy - your browser blocked clipboard access

text.tooLarge: This file is {size}, which is too large to show here.
text.unreadable: The contents of this file could not be read.

render.label: Preview mode
render.notice: Rendering runs this uploaded file in an isolated frame with no access to your account, and you do it at your own risk.
render.inert: Links, forms and downloads inside the frame are disabled.
render.rawTitle: Open the raw file in a new tab

password.prompt: This file is password-protected. Enter the password to view it.
password.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
password.remember30Help: Other files this person protects with the same password will open without asking. Anything they protect with a new password asks again.
password.rememberThisFileHelp: This file has its own password, so remembering it covers only this file.

convert.containerCopy: same picture and sound, no re-encoding
convert.webPlayable: re-encoded so a browser can play it smoothly
convert.audioTrack: the sound only, without the picture
convert.audioFormat: the same sound in another format
convert.audioAsVideo: sound on a still Modlight image, for places that only take video
convert.frameIfAnimated: if this file moves, only the first frame

document.notice: This is a preview of the document text, not of its printed pages. Layout, page breaks, headers and footers are not shown. It renders in an isolated frame with no access to your account.
document.legacyDoc: This is a Word 97-2003 document (.doc), an older binary format we cannot preview. Download it to open it in Word or a compatible editor.
document.tooLarge: This document is {size}, which is too large to preview. Download it to open it.

encrypted.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
encrypted.tooBigToSave: This browser can only save encrypted files up to {size}. Open the link in Chrome or Edge to write it straight to disk instead.
encrypted.playerUnsupported: Your browser cannot play this file.

opening.title: Opening the file
opening.body: Reading the header and unlocking it with the key from your link.

noKey.title: This link is missing its key
noKey.body: The key sits in the part of the link after the hash, and it is not here. Copy the whole link again, everything after the hash included. Without it nobody can open this file, us included.

noPreview.tooLarge: This file is {size}, too large to unpack inside a browser tab. Save it instead: it is decrypted as it downloads.
noPreview.type: This kind of file is not shown in the browser. Save it and open it in the right application.

errors.badKey: The key in this link does not open this file, or the file has been altered.
errors.notAContainer: This is not an encrypted file.
errors.truncated: This file is incomplete, so it cannot be decrypted.
errors.version: This file was written by a newer version of the app.
errors.malformed: This file could not be read.
errors.gone: This link no longer works. It may have expired or been used up.
errors.locked: This file is password protected. Unlock it first.
errors.network: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
